systems.name: creative-apps
systems.description: The macOS app shells of the creative suite: five SwiftUI apps (Flare, Design, Photo, Library, Halo), each over a Linux-safe Model target, plus the SuiteUI design system.

containers.name: SuiteUI
containers.description: The shared design system (Sources/SuiteUI): spacing, radius, type and color tokens; Liquid Glass primitives applied through one snapshot-aware modifier; the SuiteWindow shell (sidebar, content, inspector), ToolbarGroup palette, SidebarRow, SurfaceCard, GlassPanel, CanvasSurface and EmptyStateView. macOS only; knows no Model or engine.

components.name: SuiteUI sources
components.description: The shared design system (Sources/SuiteUI): spacing, radius, type and color tokens; Liquid Glass primitives applied through one snapshot-aware modifier; the SuiteWindow shell (sidebar, content, inspector), ToolbarGroup palette, SidebarRow, SurfaceCard, GlassPanel, CanvasSurface and EmptyStateView.

containers.name: FlareApp
containers.description: The Flare app (2D animation): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/FlareApp, built from SuiteUI. Reads FlareModel and calls its methods; never writes its state (scripts/ci app-state rule).

components.name: FlareApp sources
components.description: The Flare app (2D animation): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/FlareApp, built from SuiteUI.

containers.name: FlareModel
containers.description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Flare's window. FlareWorkspace: the open FlareCore document, selected scene and drawing tool. Foundation only, value types.
